UserVault.title: UserVault
UserVault.description: Private automatic cloud backup vault for a Morfo publisher.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the publisher.

visits.description: Bounded array of publisher return visits and Bible courses (max 500).

timeEntries.description: Bounded array of publisher hour logs (max 1000).

monthlyStats.description: Bounded array of monthly study count overrides (max 120).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when vault was first created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest sync.

PartnerShare.title: PartnerShare
PartnerShare.description: Shared schedule and GPS pin document for a publisher's pioneer partner or spouse.

shareCode.description: Unique 6-12 character uppercase alphanumeric share code.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the publisher sharing their schedule.

ownerName.description: Display name of the publisher sharing their schedule.

sharedVisits.description: Bounded array of sanitized schedule & GPS items (max 500).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when share document was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of latest schedule update.

/userVaults/{userId}.description: Strictly private cloud backup vault per publisher UID.

/partnerShares/{shareCode}.description: Shared schedule and map pins keyed by partner share code.
